summary: Session 2026-10-30 (pre-open). AMZN missed Q3 (EPS 1.89 vs 1.96, negative FCF second quarter, 2026 capex ~$220B with more in 2027, AWS +39%) and is -7% premarket. INTC is -25% on a weak guide. Nasdaq futures are about -2%. Premarket moves: AMD -9%, AVGO -4%, NVDA -2.7%, META -1.8%, AAPL -1%, MSFT -0.6%. The theme is AI-capex funding worry, which is overriding the rising capex plans. I held all six positions (MSFT 13%, NVDA 12%, META 10%, AVGO 8%, AAPL 8%, PLTR 5%, cash 44%) because I have no edge in trading a gap I can't see and the stops are wide (NVDA 193.7, AVGO 307.3, META 571.8, MSFT 483.6, AAPL 325.6, PLTR 175.7). Skipping AMZN and AMD before the event avoided a loss. Next session: check the actual open and close reaction. Decide whether the funding worry is spreading, in which case cut chips, or fading, in which case deploy some cash into the dip (AMD, AMZN, GOOGL are candidates, but none until the selling stabilises). AAPL earnings are around Nov 2, so check the date. Notes are updated.
